# The catalog's lead card crops its cover, and collapses beside one card

## Context

Maryam's pre-cut read of the Forms & Fields and Calendar group pages ([#21329](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21329#issuecomment-7087804083), `dev` `6942094715`) graded both below #21140's 9/10 gate: Forms 7 and 8, Calendar 6.5 and 7.5. Two of the deductions come from the same rule, the group page's 2 × 2 lead card. Captured as defect-notes `cf6d1423` and `2cd5f70e`.

## The Problem

- **Forms & Fields (four cards):** the lead, Multi-Step Account Form, loses the right edge of its cover at 1440 × 900. The phone layout shows the same cover whole.
- **Calendar (two cards on `6942094715`; three since the birthday book joined it on 22 Nov):** the lead's cover shrinks to a strip of about 3.7:1, about 195 px tall, and loses 10 AM to 4 PM of the schedule. The phone layout again shows it whole.

Every cover is captured at 16:9 (`buildScripts/docs/captureExamples.mjs`, 1280 × 720). A cover box with any other ratio crops it by construction.

## The Architectural Reality

- `resources/css/src/apps/portal/examples/List.css`: at 1100 px of list width and above, the first card of a `.portal-examples-list-lead` list spans two columns and two rows. The lead overrides the cover's ratio (`--portal-example-cover-aspect: auto`, `--portal-example-cover-height: 100%`, `aspect-ratio: auto; height: 100%` on `.preview-image-wrap`), so its cover box takes whatever height the two rows give it.
- Grid rows size to their content (`grid-auto-rows: max-content`). Beside two cards, the 2 × 2 box comes out about 14:9, and `.preview-image` (`background-size: cover; background-position: left top`) cuts the right edge of a 16:9 image. Beside one card, the second row has no other item and sizes to almost nothing, so the lead's cover collapses to a strip.
- `test/playwright/e2e/portal/ExamplesCatalogNL.spec.mjs#expectCardLayout` checks every card's cover for 16:9 *except the lead's* (`card.isLead || …`), so the crop passes CI today.
- #22024 / #22025 filled the lone final card at 3n + 1 cards, kept the lead's two-row bounds, and kept covers at their aspect ratio.

## The Fix

In `List.css`, the lead keeps its cover at the captured 16:9 instead of stretching it to the cell: drop the ratio and height overrides. The lead still spans two columns and two rows, and where two cards stand beside it, its bottom still aligns with theirs, because the caption below the cover takes the remaining height. Beside a single card, the lead's own 16:9 cover now sets the row heights instead of collapsing to them. In `ExamplesCatalogNL.spec.mjs`, the lead loses its exemption from the 16:9 check.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: At 1440 × 900, every group page's lead cover is 16:9 and shows the captured image whole; the lead still spans two columns, and with two cards beside it, its top and bottom align with theirs.
- [ ] AC-2: A lead beside one other card (Containers & Layouts) or alone (Tabs) shows its cover at 16:9 instead of a strip.
- [ ] AC-3: Phone layouts, the overview, and #22025's full-row final card are unchanged.
- [ ] AC-4: `expectCardLayout` checks the lead's cover for 16:9 like every other card, red on `dev` and green with the fix. The pull request carries before/after frames of Forms & Fields and Calendar at 1440 × 900, and of Containers & Layouts and Tabs, the one-beside and alone cases, at 1440 × 1200, where each demonstrations band shows unscrolled.

**Amended 23 Nov by the author, after Sophie's review of #22052:** AC-2 first named Calendar's lead "beside its one other card". Calendar gained its third card, the birthday book, the same night, so it now shows the two-beside crop that AC-1 covers. Containers & Layouts (two cards) and Tabs (one) now carry the one-beside and alone cases, and AC-4's frames add them. The Fix first said the caption would be centred; a more specific rule already sets the caption's alignment, so it stays top-aligned like every other card's.

## Out of Scope

- The cross-listed Form layout tile's collapsed inputs (defect-note, an example defect).
- Light covers for older records (#21942).
- Changing which card leads, or how many columns a group page has.

## Avoided Traps

- **`background-position: center` on the lead.** A 16:9 image in a 14:9 box still loses its sides; centring only moves the crop.
- **A three-row lead.** #22024 measured it: it fills the grid but crops the cover further.
